name: Burning Verdure
look: a Heatran overgrown like a forest floor: lava-splashed rust shell, charred tree-stump legs carved with glowing runes and crowned with moss and white eggs, and bare branches growing from its back, one aflame
entry: A Pokémon resembling Heatran, described in an old forester's book about a burning beast whose legs were the stumps of a forest it had set alight. Moss and saplings regrow on its back.
how: Wild: very rare in wooded badlands and windswept savannas.
